newsitem.title: DENMARK: Tele Danmark in Austria mobile bid.
newsitem.headline: Tele Danmark in Austria mobile bid.

text.p: Danish telecommunications group Tele Danmark said on Friday it had made a binding offer for 25 percent of the share capital plus one share in Austria's Mobilkom Austria.

It said that Mobilkom Austria was currently 100 percent owned by Austria's PTA national post and telecommunications organisation, which was looking for a strategic partner with whom to expand mobile telephone activities.
Tele Danmark said it was unable at the present stage to provide more information on its offer.
It said that Mobilkom Austria's mobile telephone monopoly ended last July when a new, competitive GSM system was set up.
Tele Dannark already participates in mobile telephony partnership deals in Belgium, Hungary, Poland, Ukraine and Lithuania.
